messages:
sara: Heads-up — ran a Monte Carlo straggler sim for AWQ group sizes across model variants. Observed long-tail token latency spikes starting at group-size 192 when act-quant=2 on llama2-13b-awq.
mike: Can you paste the run command + config? Which workload/dataset — canary replay or synthetic?
sara: Repro command below (short):
```
./awq_sim --model=llama2-13b-awq --group-sizes=32,64,96,192,384 --actq=2 --seed=42 --workload=lm-eval --batch=8 --kv-cache=true --iters=2000
```
sara: Quick findings: p99.5 latency jumps ~3x at gsz>=192, throughput degrades after ~500 iters. Decode error rate ~0.6% at gsz=384. I ran both prefix_cache on/off; weirdly prefix_cache=true made the tail worse.
raj: Hmm — could be KV merge / prefetch interaction with group assembly. Which kernel set/autotune was used?
sara: autotuned kernels: cuda-1.8.0, custom schedule. Forcing smaller per-device group assembly removes spikes. Also actq=3 mitigates the tail (less variance).
toni: Any correlation with sequence length distribution? Long requests can poison groups.
sara: Yes — p50 seq len ~64 but ~2% of requests >1024. The spike timestamps correlate with those long sequences. Hypothesis: mixed-length groups cause single long job to pull whole group runtime up and starve batching.
mike: @sara can you reproduce this on the serving runtime (staging) instead of sim? If so we should run a tiny canary on dedicated staging pool.
sara: Did a staging replay on pool-staging-awq — pattern replicated. Pasting a short trace snippet: 
```
[2026-03-20T10:12:34Z] batcher: assembled group id=0x8f size=256 seqlens=[64,64,...,1536]
[2026-03-20T10:12:34Z] runtime: group_exec_time=183ms (median expected 59ms)
[2026-03-20T10:12:34Z] decoder: decode_error=0.6% at group 0x8f
```
deploy-bot: Canary deployment completed: 3/3 nodes up. Logs: /var/log/awq/staging/3743219999.log
raj: :thinking_face: Looks like we need group-aware scheduling or longseq isolation. Short-term patch: detect seq>512 and route to small-group path or fallback variant with actq=3.
toni: Agreed — add a preprocessor routing rule: if seq_len>512 -> route to awq-actq3 variant (or allocate single-request group). That should protect SLOs while we refactor batcher.
sara: I'll run an A/B for 4 hours: baseline vs longseq->actq3 routing. Will collect p50/p95/p99 lat, p99.9 token tail, throughput, plus quality metrics (PPL, exact-match on validation subset).
mike: If lat-tails go away but accuracy shifts, capture deltas: PPL, EM, and hallucination rate on our eval set. Keep thresholds: PPL delta <+3% and EM drop <0.5% for auto-rollout.
sara: Plan noted. I'll post summary and the small CSV of runs shortly.
toni: Also open an infra ticket to refactor batcher so group assembly is length-aware. Assign to @raj.
sara: Ticket created: INF-8342 — "batcher: length-aware grouping + longseq routing". Linking logs and sim artifacts in the ticket.
sara: :eyes: thanks all, will update with canary numbers in ~2h.
